rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=20, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.05, finetune_epochs=8, finetune_lr=0.0015, unet_c=32, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-11: KNOB=finetune_lr: 5e-4→1.5e-3 (3×). iter-10 (k=2) catastrophically regressed SSIM 0.221 — k=2 breaks the DC gradient flow on Mayo. Revert k=1, ep=20 (iter-8/9 sweet spot 0.118/0.120), push finetune lr 3× to extract more from the proven UNet pretrain. Hypothesis: ep=20 plateau is due to undertrained finetune at lr=5e-4 — 3× lr should let the joint-mode optimization squeeze the last gain.
